note: The signing keys every shipped package revokes, as key IDs (16 lowercase hex digits). Empty until a key has been revoked in the field. sign-candidate.sh writes this list into the bundled package as revokedKeys, which only a recovery key may sign, and ShippedRegistryDataTest checks that the bundle restates every ID here. Never remove an ID: a package that omits a revocation the device holds is refused.
